Definition: from G3326 and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the countenance):--forehead.
BiblicalUsage: John seals God's servants in their foreheads, spares those with the seal, and shows the Lamb's company with the Father's name written in their foreheads, while the beast marks his followers in the same place. The forehead is where belonging is written, and Revelation makes it the mark of whose we are.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the forehead is the right place for the seal: it is the most visible part of a man, and God writes His name there so that all heaven can see whose servant stands before Him. God writes His name where all heaven can see it, so that no one mistakes whose servant stands there.
